title: ControlLoop
description: Definition of one instantiation of the shared control-loop kernel: sense → decide under a digest-pinned policy → act through a gate → verify → record. One kernel, three sanctioned domains (compute, governance, learning). Deliberate closures of the source-diagram defects: the loop is a long-running service with first-class idle ticks and NO terminal End state; the anomaly path carries a bounded retry budget with a mandatory escalation target (no livelock); scheduling has exactly one arbitrated re-entry point (no racing feedback edges); the governing policy is pinned by digest, never by moving tag. Fail-mode invariant (enforced by if/then): fail-open requires an explicit recorded justification — fail-closed is the posture that needs no defense.

specVersion.description: Epistemic-kernel contract version, pinned. Changing this const is a contract change.

domain.description: Which kernel instantiation this is: compute (federated resource loop), governance (guardrail runtime), or learning (trainer/rollout). Closed set at v0.1 — a fourth domain is a contract change, not a string.

policyDigest.description: Content digest of the exact policy version in force. Invariant: consumers pin by digest, never by tag or 'latest' — a moving policy reference is the moving-tag deployment trap restated.

failMode.description: Behavior when a decide- or verify-phase dependency is unavailable. fail-closed is the default posture; fail-open requires failOpenJustification (enforced by if/then).

failOpenJustification.description: Recorded justification for a fail-open posture. Required when failMode is fail-open.

maxAdjustmentsPerIncident.description: Maximum automatic adjust-phase attempts for one incident before escalation is mandatory. Closes the source diagram's anomaly livelock (its anomaly path never re-reached an exit check).

escalationRef.description: URN or stable reference of the escalation target (human queue, incident channel). Mandatory — a retry budget without an escalation target is a declared-unenforced control.

retryBudget.description: Bounded automatic-adjustment budget with a mandatory escalation target.

minSecondsBetweenAdjustments.description: Minimum wall-clock seconds between consecutive adjust actions.

hysteresis.description: Optional damping between adjustments so the loop cannot thrash the scheduler.

schedulerArbitration.description: Re-entry discipline into the act/schedule phase. Closed to single-entry at v0.1: all feedback edges (adjustments, monitor feedback) merge through one arbitrated entry point. The source diagram's two uncoordinated scheduler re-entry edges are a race by construction.

idleTickSeconds.description: Idle-tick interval when no new data or work is available. The loop is a service: 'no new data' produces an idle ControlLoopTick, never a terminal End state.

rel.description: Relation of the linked artifact to this loop (e.g. derived_from, design_register).

ref.description: URN or stable reference of the linked artifact.

provenanceLinks.description: Typed provenance links (e.g. to the DesignRegister entry that mechanized this loop).
